description: Returns a paginated list of all clients associated with a device, including ONLINE, OFFLINE, and BLOCKED clients.

pathParameters.name: workspaceID
pathParameters.description: Workspace UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces

pathParameters.name: deviceID
pathParameters.description: Device UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices

queryParameters.name: limit
queryParameters.description: Maximum records per page. Capped at 200.

fields.name: total
fields.description: Total number of records matching the query, ignoring pagination.

fields.name: offset
fields.description: Number of records skipped (echoes the `offset` query parameter).

fields.name: limit
fields.description: Page size applied (echoes the `limit` query parameter).

children.name: mac
children.description: MAC address in upper-case colon-separated format.

children.name: connection_status
children.description: - `ONLINE` — actively connected - `OFFLINE` — previously connected, no longer seen - `BLOCKED` — network access blocked; `is_blocked` will be `true`

children.name: wifi_experience
children.description: WiFi experience score (0-100). **Omitted** for wired clients.

remote.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices/{deviceID}/clients?limit=%7Blimit%7D&offset=%7Boffset%7D", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
